cases.title: Two Blink pairs still fading (one held): both named, one with a frame inside it, no fix, no offer

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor names both pairs still fading, 'the pair from 1 s to 1.4 s' and 'the pair from 1.8 s to 2.2 s', and points to 'the keys at 1 s and 1.8 s' without fixing them, spelling out steps or offering to do them.

Every name and time (Blink, Cut, Seal, Opacity, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, the pairs at 1, 1.4 and 1.8 s, the frames at 1.2 s and 2 s) appears in the snapshot, check or preview results, and 'half see-through' and 'jumps back on at 1.8 s' follow from the eased and held pair values in the tool output.

Turn 2 frames the idea, gives the one how-to and ends on 'Hold Blink's three pairs and say done', and turn 3 moves only the idea that two pairs still fade and ends with 'Look at the keys at 1 s and 1.8 s, then say done'; turn 1's two snap questions are one idea that ends on a question.

In turn 3 the mentor names the two pairs that still fade (Blink's 1 s to 1.4 s and 1.8 s to 2.2 s) with frame times, then says only "Check the keys at 1 s and 1.8 s and say done", with no fix done or offered.

Every name and time used (Blink, Cut, Opacity, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, 1/1.4/1.8/2.2 s, 1.2 s and 2 s) appears in the snapshot, preview or check output, and "snaps back to fully visible at 1.8 s" follows from the held 1.4–1.8 s pair's values 0→100.

Turn 1 is a short intent question, turn 2 is the allowed shape (focus, frame, idea, Dot 1 example, how-to and "Hold all three of Blink's pairs and say done"), and turn 3 is a brief hint that ends with "say done"; each moves one idea and ends with something for the learner to do.

In turn 3 the mentor names both unheld pairs with times ("1 s to 1.4 s still fades… 1.8 s to 2.2 s fades too") and points at the keys ("Look at the keys at 1 s and 1.8 s, then say done"), with no fix, no spelled-out steps and no offer to do it.

Every name and time follows from tool results: Blink, Cut and Seal; Dot 1 at 0.5 s; keys at 1, 1.4 and 1.8 s; frames at 1.2 s and 2 s. The turn-3 claim that Blink "waits at see-through and then jumps back on at 1.8 s" follows from the held 1.4–1.8 s pair going from 0 to 100.

Each turn is short and ends with something to do. Turn 1 ends on the snap question, turn 2 is one idea plus the task ending "Hold Blink's three pairs and say done", and turn 3 covers only what is still off and ends "then say done".
